title: Twelvemile Beach Campground is closed for the season
detail: Re-verified directly on nps.gov: all of Pictured Rocks' drive-in campgrounds (Twelvemile Beach, Hurricane River, Little Beaver Lake) run May 15–Oct 15 only, with water and toilets shut off after that. This visit lands Oct 16, 2026 — the day after closing, so it's confirmed closed, not just borderline. The itinerary still lists it as the planned overnight; use Tahquamenon Falls SP (Rivermouth/Lower Falls campground, likely open but worth confirming) or the Soo Locks Campground in Sault Ste. Marie, MI (a real municipal RV park/campground, season May 1–Oct 20, comfortably covers this date) instead.

title: Van Riper State Park's camping season may not cover this date
detail: Michigan DNR's official 2026 operating-dates page couldn't be pulled directly, but the 2025 season closed Oct 17 (cabins Oct 14) — close enough to this trip's Oct 15, 2026 date that it isn't a sure thing. Call the park or check MiDNRReservations.com before counting on it; have a Marquette-area motel as backup.

title: Belle Fourche River Campground is right at the end of its season
detail: This is the real NPS campground at Devils Tower National Monument. Its season runs roughly May 16–Oct 14 per recreation.gov — the planned Oct 12, 2026 visit is very likely fine but is right at the tail end. Worth a quick confirmation call to the monument (307-467-5283) before relying on it.
